neighbours.label: The close of two set phrases: ' every' in 'each and every' and ' other' in 'various other'; ' every' and ' other' outside the phrase, and ' each' and ' various' before other words, stay lower, on a broad, gate-closed pole.
fire: The clerk checks each and every box on the form.
We read each and every note they sent.
Clean each and every part before you start.
She thanked each and every guest at the door.
You can pay with cards and various other methods.
The kit comes with knives and various other tools.
They sell soap, candles and various other gifts.
He tried tea and various other remedies.
quiet: The clerk checks each new box on the form.
We read every note they sent.
Clean the big part before you start.
She thanked the last guest at the door.
You can pay with cards and various apps.
The kit comes with knives and other tools.
They sell soap, candles and small gifts.
He tried tea and various herbal remedies.

short: ' every' in 'each and every'; ' other' in 'various other'
notes: The card flags a broad pole (1.7% of tokens) that is gate-closed at the top, with text that reads as machine-spun marketing. Probes: ' every' 0.74, ' other' 0.49; ' effect', ' use' and ' number' 0.12-0.24, with near misses about the same, so those are left out. Near misses may leak on such a pole, and ' every' peaks only once in the card's top 32, so coverage will be low.
